Name: (FS) Deer Tails for Fashion Sense
Author: StarfallStorms
Description:
[size=3]I was inspired to make this mod because I wanted a deer tail to match other mods that I enjoy, but I wasn't able to find one that suited me. So, I made these! [/size]

[size=3]This mod is an accessory content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url][/size]

[size=3][b]Tail Colors:[/b]
- 1.0.0: Black, Blonde, Brown, and Wine Red[/size]
[size=3]
- ﻿1.0.2: Added Custom Color Option!

- 1.0.5: Added Custom Option w/ Black Base, Fire, Fire w/ Alt Back Facing, Pastel Blue, Pastel Pink, Pastel Purple, Two Prismatic Options (Black or White Base)

- 1.0.6: Added Full Custom Color Option! (Both Top and Base Colors are Customizable)[/size]
[size=5]Installation:[/size]
[size=3] 1. Make sure you have the latest versions of both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] installed.
 2. Download the mod file and ﻿unzip the folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
 3. Run the game through SMAPI

[b]If Updating: 
[/b]1. Delete previous version from your Mods folder.
2. Download latest version and unzip it into your Mods folder
3. Run the game through SMAPI
[/size]
[size=3]Thank you for your support! I hope you’ll enjoy your new look![/size]

[size=3]The antlers seen in the images are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2982]Seasonal Hats for Content Patcher and JsonAssets[/url][/size]
